items.title: Model Training Library, first cut
items.detail: scripts/training-set.mjs: one row per settled short in the 18-month catalog with its pre-publish features (src/lib/video-features.ts), outcome, and content features where analyzed. 18,455 rows, 2,739 breakouts, 64 channels; manifest committed, rows rebuilt locally.

items.title: VAR model v0
items.detail: L2 logistic regression on pre-publish metadata, leave-one-channel-out: AUC 0.60 (0.56 knowing only the channel's family and size), within a channel 0.55, top decile 1.4x the base rate; Reform family 0.47. Metadata is a weak prior; the signal has to come from the video and the first hours of the curve. src/lib/forecast.ts applies it and turns the measured within-channel lifts into distribution advice; parity with the trainer checked.
